llm.note: PMK 9/2021 re-enacts the PPh 21 DTP for Masa Pajak January to June 2021 with the same criteria and a new KLU annex, so the closed 2020 rules are mirrored by 2021 records; the Pasal 2 ayat (6) exclusion uses a new employee input income_from_state_budget_dtp. output.reason: Pasal 2 grants a government-borne PPh 21 facility (PPh 21 DTP) for employees with specific criteria: the employer has a listed KLU code, is a KITE company or holds a bonded zone (Kawasan Berikat/PDKB) licence, the employee has an NPWP, and annualized regular gross income is not more than Rp200,000,000. The employer must pay the tax in cash to the employee, and that benefit is not counted as taxable income. This changes the net PPh 21 burden and the take-home calculation for eligible permanent employees for tax periods January to June 2021 (Pasal 18). The rest of the document covers other taxes (final PPh under PP 23/2018, construction, PPh 22 import, PPh 25, VAT) and reporting procedures, which do not affect PPh 21.
